name: Assistant Naturalist, Earth Focus Day Camp
what_you_do: Volunteers help lead kids on hikes, nature games and science activities at a summer day camp in the Arboretum. Orientation and training are provided.
who_can_apply: The page says adults and teens interested in nature education can serve as assistant naturalists. No exact age is stated.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Ask for the assistant naturalist schedule.
how_to_apply: Contact volunteer program manager Judy Kingsbury at (608) 262-5604 or judith.kingsbury@wisc.edu.
notes: Drop-in restoration work parties run most Saturday mornings from mid-February through mid-December. Check the Arboretum events calendar for times. The page does not state a minimum age for them.
